name: Walk This Way LLC

reviews.text: Walk This Way is a great company with amazing staff! They are very accommodating. I can go away for 10 days and know that my cat is in great hands. Everyday they take pictures and leave you little notes on how your pet did. They are great!
reviews.author: JESSICA NYDICK

reviews.text: Highly recommend, been using Walk This Way for around three years and they never let me down. Always great service for my best bud!
reviews.author: Eric Stabach

reviews.text: Recently starting using this service. My wife, dog, and I are extremely happy with Dara and her team. The level of detail inculcated into the business warrants many complements. They are flexible and are willing work with my chaotic hospital schedule. Fairly priced and extremely communicative. I trust my beloved dog with them and trust that she is in good hands. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael Oliver Mudry

reviews.text:
Walk This Way is a reliable dog walking service based in Manyuank. I've been using them for about two years and love them. I had a pre-scheduled weekly walk last year when I had my late night at work. On other days, they were flexible if I had a last minute meeting. They would try to have someone available.

The price is very reasonable for the sense of security you get. Dara in the office is quick to respond to calls and emails. Benny has had a few different walkers and they always leave a note on the kitchen table detailing the events of the walk.

Update: I had daily walks (Monday-Friday) for a few months and they are still amazing. Faith now answers the phone but Dara is still there. I had a slight issue last year involving a combination of the post office and my bank's bill pay checks being delayed so I saw a huge balance on my invoice. Dara was understanding of the issue and helpful in figuring everything out.

Update (Again): Since my last update, I no longer use them for daily walks because I changed jobs and don't have as long of hours daily. On those days when I do need someone to walk Benny, they are always available and I know Benny is in good hands. Also since my last review, they started accepting Venmo so I no longer have the delay in payments getting from the bank to them.
reviews.author: Cori Frede

reviews.text: The wonderful woman of Walk This Way take amazing care of our kitties whenever we go out of town. We are able to relax knowing they are safe, fed, and getting their regular meds. Walk this way also provides updates and notes from each visit. I highly recommend them for cat sitting.
reviews.author: Jess Charwin
